title: Lionel Messi holds a baby Lamine Yamal

paragraphs: Ahead of the highly anticipated World Cup final between Argentina and Spain, Lionel Messi reflected on his connection with the rising Spanish star, Lamine Yamal.

Messi described a viral photograph taken years ago, showing him holding Yamal as a tiny baby, as completely crazy. He noted how remarkable it is that the baby from the photo has now grown up to face him on football’s biggest international stage. The 19-year-old Yamal was praised by Messi as one of the best players in the world right now, with a historic career ahead of him.

As a loyal Barcelona supporter, Messi expressed that he truly wishes Yamal the absolute best for the future, since his success directly benefits the Spanish club. However, Messi firmly stated that during the final, Argentina would give their maximum effort and do everything possible to defend against him, making sure Yamal couldn’t perform at his absolute best this time.

But Messi explained that Argentina would do everything they can to stop Yamal during the game. He wanted his team to play a great match so that the young star couldn’t play his best version in the final.
